title: Grok Build plugin manifest traps
behavior_delta: Point mcpServers in .grok-plugin/plugin.json at a file path (./.grok-plugin/mcp.json) anchored with ${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT}; never inline it, never use ${VAR:-default}, and name the marketplace plugin source by git URL, not "./". Check changes with `grok mcp doctor` from an isolated HOME/USERPROFILE, not `grok plugin validate`.
what: Point mcpServers in .grok-plugin/plugin.json at a file path (./.grok-plugin/mcp.json) anchored with ${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT}; never inline it, never use ${VAR:-default}, and name the marketplace plugin source by git URL, not "./". Check changes with `grok mcp doctor` from an isolated HOME/USERPROFILE, not `grok plugin validate`.
why: Grok 1.0.41 ignored an inline mcpServers object and fell back to the root .mcp.json, whose relative mcp.js resolved in the user's project; it expands ${VAR} but not ${VAR:-default}; its marketplace rejects "./" as 'marketplace path is empty'. grok plugin validate passed on all of these.
